title: "Gemini Makes Precision Maneuvers" – Washington Post p. A6, with Mission Control photo
description: Washington Post page A6 clipping headed "Gemini Makes Precision Maneuvers" with the sub-story "Chronological Account of Orbits As Space Flight Enters 3d Day". A photograph at upper left shows a woman seated with others in a viewing area overlooking consoles; its caption identifies Mrs. Charles Conrad Jr. watching the progress of her husband's Gemini 5 flight. Adjacent short items include "Disposal of Body Waste Is Easy for Astronauts", "Venus Heat Held Caused By Snowfall" and "Fainting Possible At Orbits' End".
